title: S3.7c rooted reachable-node and graph-link source identity consistency

scope.operation: Conservatively classify rooted ACIS projections whose retained row identities disagree with the reachable-node census.
invariants: reachable node identities are nonnegative and unique
every graph-link source belongs to the rooted reachable-node set
retained lump, shell, face, loop, and coedge row identities belong to the rooted reachable-node set
scope.resourcePolicy: Copy reachable IDs into one compact vector, sort once, and use binary search for exact membership checks. Scratch allocation failure is caught by the noexcept classifier and conservatively produces a known-gap result.
scope.semanticLimit: Internal projection consistency only. The reachable set and graphLinks are produced by the same parser and do not establish source-file completeness, native ACIS semantics, B-rep validity, or consumer acceptance.

new_controls: geometry graph-link source removed from reachable IDs while the cached reachable count is updated
duplicate reachable body identity with the cached reachable count updated
